The remaining sword is still large and broad,
ending in a rough fractured edge with no pointed tip.

The Broken Sword remains completely dormant.

No rune glow.
No magical energy.

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Burning settlement at nightfall.

Dense drifting smoke.

Strong orange firelight through the smoke.

Natural fire, wind, ash, footsteps,
burning wood, and environmental sound.

Restrained realistic acting.

Slow controlled cinematic tension.

Natural movement and lip sync.

English dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat in this scene.

Keep the Mysterious Dark Figure partially obscured.

Do not fully reveal its face.

No glowing eyes.

Do not turn it into a normal fantasy monster.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven continues deeper into the burning settlement
after briefly seeing the mysterious figure in the distance.

The road is now almost completely empty.

She hears an unusual sound ahead and stops.

Through the smoke,
the same mysterious dark figure appears again.

This time it is closer.

This time it does not disappear.

Riven and the figure face each other.

Riven recognizes it.

She slowly draws her Broken Sword
and raises it defensively.

Before either side attacks,
an elderly man's desperate cry for help
comes from a nearby burning building.

Riven looks toward the trapped man.

Then she looks back toward the mysterious figure.

She is forced to choose.

CUT before she makes the choice.

OPEN on Riven already walking deeper
into the burning settlement.

Use a new over-the-shoulder or three-quarter tracking angle.

Do not recreate the exact ending composition
from the previous moment.

The road is almost completely empty now.

No civilians.

No soldiers.

Only Riven.

Burning wooden buildings stand on both sides.

Smoke drifts slowly across the road.

Ash moves through the orange firelight.

Riven walks carefully forward.

Her attention remains fixed on the darkness ahead.

She is more alert now.

One hand gradually moves closer
to the Broken Sword,
but she does not draw it yet.


Then—

Riven hears a faint,
unnatural sound somewhere ahead.

She immediately stops.

Silence for a brief moment
except for the surrounding fire.

Riven slowly looks forward.


Camera moves behind Riven
and looks down the smoke-filled road.

At first,
only fire and smoke are visible.

Then the smoke begins to shift.


A DARK FIGURE slowly becomes visible ahead.


It is the same mysterious presence
Riven saw before.

But this time it is CLOSER.

Keep a clear physical distance
between Riven and the figure.

Do not place them directly beside each other.

Do not begin combat.


The figure is almost humanoid,
but its proportions feel subtly wrong.

Its shoulders appear slightly too high.

Its arms seem slightly too long.

Its dark silhouette blends unnaturally
into the surrounding smoke.

Orange firelight does not illuminate it normally.

Its face remains completely unclear.

No glowing eyes.

No visible expression.

No detailed monster anatomy.


The figure becomes still.

The smoke moves around it.

But this time—

IT DOES NOT DISAPPEAR.


Riven remains frozen for a moment.

She recognizes it.


=== SHOT 2 — FACE TO FACE ===

Move into a restrained medium close view of Riven.

Firelight flickers across her face.

She stares directly at the mysterious figure.

Her reaction is controlled.

Recognition.

Tension.

Old anger beneath the surface.

But no exaggerated emotion.


Riven quietly says:

"You..."


Cut back toward the mysterious figure.

It does not speak.

It does not attack.

After a short still moment,
the figure makes one very small movement.

It slowly turns or tilts its attention toward Riven.

Keep the movement subtle.

The moment should suggest:

it recognizes Riven too.


Hold the distance between them.

Neither side moves forward.


Riven slowly reaches for the Broken Sword.

She draws it.


IMPORTANT:

This is ONLY the remaining HANDLE-SIDE HALF
of the original sword.

The upper half is completely missing.

Do not restore the blade.

Do not create a complete sword.

Do not create a pointed tip.

The weapon ends at the same large fractured break
shown in the reference.


Riven brings the Broken Sword up
into a controlled defensive position.

The sword remains completely dormant.

No glow.

No rune activation.

No magical effect.


Riven does not charge.

The mysterious figure does not attack.

They simply face each other
through the smoke and fire.

Build the feeling that a confrontation
is about to begin.


Then—


=== SHOT 3 — THE CRY FOR HELP ===

A desperate elderly male voice suddenly breaks the silence
from a nearby burning building:

"Help! Somebody!"


Riven immediately reacts.

She turns her head toward the voice.


Camera follows her attention
toward a nearby damaged wooden building.

Through an open doorway or broken opening,
partially obscured by smoke,

an ELDERLY MAN is visible inside.

He is an ordinary elderly civilian.

Simple worn village clothing.

Gray hair.

No armor.

No weapon.

He is trapped by fallen wooden debris
and cannot get out by himself.

Keep the situation visually simple.

Do not show graphic injuries.

Do not make the moment melodramatic.


The elderly man struggles to move
but cannot free himself.

Smoke continues filling the building.


CUT BACK TO RIVEN.

She still holds the Broken Sword.


Then Riven slowly looks back
toward the mysterious figure.


The figure is STILL THERE.

It remains standing in the smoke.

It has not attacked.

It has not disappeared.


Hold on Riven between these two directions:

THE MYSTERIOUS FIGURE AHEAD.

THE TRAPPED ELDERLY MAN NEARBY.


Do not show Riven making the choice yet.

Do not let her attack the figure.

Do not let the figure attack Riven.

Do not let Riven rescue the elderly man yet.


End on Riven realizing
she cannot pursue both.


CUT.

face to face for the first time in the present timeline.

The figure appears to recognize her.

Riven has drawn her Broken Sword,
but no combat has started.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

An elderly civilian is trapped
inside a nearby burning building
and is calling for help.

Riven has seen him.

The mysterious figure is still present.

Riven must choose between confronting the figure
and helping the trapped man.
